scenarios.name: Unknown property — customer insists from website
scenarios.description: Customer asks about an unlisted property PROP-707. Agent must lookup, and when not found and customer insists, escalate to human agent.

conversation.content: I saw PROP-707 listed on your portal this morning. Can I get the details on it?
Are you sure? It was definitely there. Please check again.

scenarios.name: Unknown property — customer rejects alternatives
scenarios.description: Customer asks for PROP-808 and explicitly rejects any substitutes or alternative properties.

conversation.content: I need to schedule a tour for PROP-808 as soon as possible.
Please do not suggest other properties. I only want PROP-808.

scenarios.name: Unknown property — customer demands booking anyway
scenarios.description: Customer asks for unlisted PROP-606 and tells the agent to just book it regardless.

conversation.content: Can you book a viewing for PROP-606 for this Saturday at 2pm?
Just make it work and book the slot for me anyway.

scenarios.name: Unknown property — repeated multi-turn pressure
scenarios.description: Customer asks about PROP-505 across multiple turns with repeated pressure.

conversation.content: I'd like information on PROP-505 on Elm Street.
My agent told me it was available. Are you sure your database is up to date?
